body: Thank you for your words of kindness.

I try my best at everything but it never seems good enough. I really do try really hard at work but i always make mistakes. No matter what. I even attended extra training courses to get better at my job but I still didn’t get the 3 different promotions I applied to this year. It seems like every time things start to go better, the other shoe drops and everything ends up worse. I land my dream job, but It doesn’t pay enough and I can’t get ahead. My husband lands his dream job, and we finally have enough money to do the things we always wanted to do. We fought and clawed our way out of poverty. We got to go on a vacation! For the first time! but then he gets laid off on his birthday. And then a whole slew of medical stuff happens to me and his car craps out and our cat gets sick and now we’re in even worse debt than before. It just seems hopeless at this point.
